disclosure: Prepared by the publisher of Conversion Calculator Plus; not an independent review or hands-on benchmark.
methodology: Selection is the 12-result public US iPhone web storefront search observed on 26 October 2026, including our app and these 11 competitors. Publisher descriptions and version histories establish documented claims, not independently measured performance. Unknown features are not treated as absent. Category groupings differ; counts of conversion pairs, units and categories are not interchangeable. Search order is not a permanent ranking or a native-iPhone ranking claim.

storefrontObservation.surface: Apple public web storefront viewed in browser

ourApp.name: Conversion Calculator Plus
verifiedFacts: 72 conversion categories and 685 non-currency units; category counts describe product organization, not an independent quality score.
Measurement conversion, currency/crypto/precious-metal comparison and an expression calculator for supported converters.
Currency+ compares several currencies in one list and checks rates every minute while its rates page is visible, the app is active and internet is connected.
A rate check does not guarantee a new market observation. The one-minute policy does not describe widget or background updates.
Previously loaded rates and currency charts remain usable offline; new pairs, uncached chart ranges and fresh rates require internet.
Automatic conversion history and favorites; Simple and Carousel modes; hide unused units, currencies and categories.
iPhone and iPad support. Siri action availability depends on the device Siri language.
Free version has banner ads and no full-page ads. Optional annual Premium removes banners and unlocks interactive Home Screen widgets and Siri conversions.
The app compares amounts and converts units; it does not execute transfers or cryptocurrency trades.

competitors.name: Unit Converter - Best Unit App
competitors.publishedFacts: 20 categories; 155 currencies; daily rate download when opened. Version history also documents calculator, favorites, fractions and compound units.
competitors.reasonToChooseOurApp: Choose 72 published categories and minute-by-minute connected Currency+ checks for broader category coverage and more frequent automatic checking.
competitors.comparisonConclusion: Our published category count is larger, and our active Currency+ rate-check interval is shorter than the stated daily download. The practical benefit is revisiting currency comparisons during the day.
competitors.tradeoffsAndUnknowns: Category groupings differ. Units Plus already has calculation and repeat-use tools; we do not present those as exclusive to our app.
